title: Earth Ambassador
question: What did I learn this year, and how can I share it?
questionZh: 这一年我学到了什么？怎样讲给别人听？

tasks.title: Read: The Council Asks About Weather

passage.title: The Council Asks About Weather
passage.text: Dear Earth friend, We are the Star Council of Bix. On Bix, the weather is always the same. Zib told us that Earth has four seasons: winter, spring, summer, and autumn. In winter, it can be cold and snowy, so people wear mittens. In summer, it can be hot, so people wear sunscreen. On rainy days, people wear rain boots. A meteorologist tells people what the weather will be. In a storm, the best place to be is indoors. The Star Council

tasks.title: Read: The Council Asks About Senses

passage.title: The Council Asks About Senses
passage.text: Dear Earth friend, Thank you for the weather report! Here is a funny thing. We on Bix can see, hear, and touch, but we cannot smell or taste. Zib says people have five senses. You smell with your nose. A rose smells sweet. Smoke can tell you there may be a fire. You taste with your tongue. Food can taste sweet, salty, sour, or bitter. Lemons taste sour! Can you teach us more about your senses? The Star Council

tasks.title: Read: The Ant and the Dove

passage.title: The Ant and the Dove
passage.text: Once upon a time, an ant went to a river to get a drink. Splash! The ant fell into the water. A dove saw the ant from a tree. The dove dropped a leaf into the river. The ant climbed onto the leaf and got back to land. Later, a man with a net tried to catch the dove. The ant bit the man on his foot. "Ouch!" he yelled. The dove heard him and flew away. If you help others, they may help you, too.

passage.title: Help Bix Stay Clean
passage.text: Dear Earth friend, We have a problem on Bix. There is trash everywhere! Zib says people on Earth can help. They reduce, reuse, and recycle. They put food scraps in a compost pile, and worms help turn them into soil. They do not litter. They turn off the water and the lights when they are not using them. Little things add up to big things. What should we do first? Please tell us! The Star Council

tasks.title: Read: You Are an Earth Ambassador

passage.title: You Are an Earth Ambassador
passage.text: Dear Earth friend, Thank you! You taught us about weather, senses, stories, and taking care of a planet. Now Bix is cleaner, and Zib is very happy. The Star Council wants to give you a special name. You are an Earth Ambassador! An ambassador is a person who helps two places be friends. Please come to the Star Core. Bring all the words you learned. We will have a party for you! The Star Council
